_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): every seed (instances/<slug>/ with IDEA.md and instance.json) is built, deployed, verified live and wired into autonomous operation, with a design goal of one year unattended. Read by foundation/seedlife.py and seed/scripts/seedlife.py (the engine every system carries). A seed's answers live in instances/<slug>/lifecycle.json; survival classes are answered closed (probe), n/a (reason), gate (identity-bound, default in effect, one https link: the honest record of what cannot be unattended) or open (queue item), or inherit a core input from doctrine/unattended.json. Tests tests/foundation/test_seedlife.py.

survival.what: every credential the seed's loops use renews itself or is probed for expiry before it lapses
the code host token the lane merges and deploys with renews itself
a monthly budget is declared and the free-plan governor caps spend inside it
a cost or usage spike is seen and acted on by a loop, not by a person reading a bill
the account the seed runs on stays paid or on a free plan with no card that can lapse
package and action dependencies are updated by Dependabot and merged by the sweeper
the runtime (Node, compatibility date) is moved ahead of end of life
no retired hosted model id; a retired model heals on the same rung
a live probe of the seed with self-remediation (redeploy, rollback, restart)
data the seed stores is backed up off the platform and restored in a drill
the domain or hostname the seed is served on renews by itself
the seed keeps improving with no outside session (the self-coder takes its items)
personal data is minimal, retention is declared and deletion works

not_seeds.spinoffs: the app registry of the spinoff loop; each app is launched, measured and retired by foundation/spinoff.py, not a seed
not_seeds.qnfo: the adoption case of an external fleet run from QNFO repositories outside this org; judged there (instances/qnfo/README.md)

fixtures.demo-child: a bootstrap input that tests/test_vision.py (LayerTests) reads to prove a child reports to its parent; its IDEA.md says it exists to prove that, not to run
